title: Log Hunter
story: The control room keeps logs as lines like 2024-05-01 10:00:02 ERROR disk full. Count how many lines each level has.
goal: Write count_levels(log) returning a dict from level (the third word on each line) to how many lines have it. Ignore blank lines.

tests.label: Counts
tests.expr:
count_levels("2024-05-01 10:00:01 INFO ok
2024-05-01 10:00:02 ERROR disk full
2024-05-01 10:00:03 ERROR db down
")

hints: Split the log into lines, then each line into words. The level is the third word.
log.splitlines() gives lines. counts.get(level, 0) + 1 keeps the tally.
socratic: Which word on each line is the level?
What should happen to a blank line?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Log Hunter”?
